name: macintosh.js
description: Macintosh's System 8 in a Tauri app.

scripts.build: npm run disk:assemble && npm run build:renderer && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.68k.conf.json
scripts.build:ppc: npm run disk:assemble:ppc && npm run build:renderer:ppc && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.ppc.conf.json --features ppc
scripts.package: npm run disk:assemble && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.68k.conf.json --no-bundle
scripts.package:ppc: npm run disk:assemble:ppc && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.ppc.conf.json --features ppc --no-bundle
scripts.make: npm run disk:assemble && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.68k.conf.json
scripts.publish: npm run disk:assemble && tauri build --config src-tauri/tauri.68k.conf.json
